features.quote: A distress-rollout ceiling. `check_rollout_budget` refuses runs above an explicit cap
features.justification_quote: so a config typo can't silently launch an enormous distress sweep

features.quote: No gratuitous escalation. `allow_custom_escalation=False`: we use only the rejection styles the paper defines
features.justification_quote: do not invent harsher prompts to "improve" elicitation
